title: Banjo players and the soprano saxophone
summary: Another banjoist, Harold Dejan and the soprano sax, and the difficulty of clarinet.

blocks.x: Oh, I never did get much more about Clara Statham. You said they had Raymond Brown and George McCullum. And myself. And?
And now, Harry Fagli too, he's playing banjo.
I'm going to see him Sunday if I can. Where? Over the Lake? Over the Lake Harrow and I'm supposed to drive over there. Oh yeah?
I won't be telling him if you saw me. I'll write it down. Yes, he's a boy so friend that I am. I haven't played it to. And Warren Bennett was playing Town of the Lake Swan. He's over there too.
Yes, I'm just saying. You know all those times? No, but Harold tells me about him. He's going to, uh, he's going to introduce me to them all. Oh, I understand. Oh, who is it Harold?
Don't know. Yeah. I don't know. Harold is a fine teller. He's a good man. He's been born by everybody.

Yeah, he's always nice, Harold Desjardins. If you ever meet him. We have a man. You'll meet him someday, you know. I've been hoping he'd get on Soprano too. Ian Harold, that man would make quite a novelty now.
Have you ever seen a soprano sax? Yes, I mean a little short.
Uh-huh, yeah. And not many of them around.

Oh, yeah, that's right too. They're very, very bad instruments too. You've got to control them with their lips and the fingers. They're so small, you know what I mean? Half the finger knows the horn like this. And then you get on that. It's equivalent to a clarinet. I mean a close finger. Well, it's much easier to play it than a clarinet, of course. A clarinet is very bad on it. A clarinet is one instrument that if you start playing it, you better stay on it. Because after you once get off it, hmm, it's bad. You have to double up your lip and all kind of things and get back on it. I know.
